lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: You have called us out of darkest night into your glorious light
That we may shake the wonders of the risen Christ
May our every breath retell the grace That broke into our strife
With boundless love and deepest joy
With endless light
Let the people praise you
Let the nations be glad
All your blessing comes that we may praise

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: Name of Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: All the earth is yours and all within
Each harvest is your own
And from your hand we give to you to make Christ known
May the seeds of mercy grow in us for those who
Have not heard
May songs of praise,
The lives of grace to spread your word
Let the peoples praise you

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Let the nations be glad
All your blessing comes that we may praise
May we praise the name of Jesus

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: It's a holy privilege to declare your praises and your name
To every nation, tribe,
And tongue your church proclaims
May the peoples praise you,
Let the nations be glad
All your blessing comes that we may praise,
May we praise the name of Jesus
Holy, holy is the Lord Almighty

lyrics.label: Verse 4
lines: Worthy, worthy is the Lamb who was slain
Holy holy is the lord almighty all creation praise
Your glorious name
May the peoples praise you let
Let the nations be glad
All your blessing comes that we may praise
May praise the name of Jesus
May the people praise you Let

lyrics.label: Chorus
lines: Let the nations be glad
All your blessing comes that we may praise
May praise the name of Jesus
We'll be right back
